facts.fact: WeAreTech.Africa reports that the government, through the Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation, 'recently launched' a recruitment to select a consultant to draft the next national digital strategy, called Togo Digital 2025-2030, which updates the strategic framework set up in 2020; no adopting act is given; dated by the article's publication date, 2025-05-28.

The article says the previous strategic framework of 2020 had enabled notable advances, naming the e-Gouv government platform, digital service centres and cybersecurity and data protection laws, with no target or report cited; dated by the article's publication date, 2025-05-28.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation

systems.country_label: stratégie nationale de transformation numérique (framework of 2020)

note: The article says the 2020 national strategy 'touche à sa fin' but states no period, adoption act or text, so no period fact; the successor is at drafting stage with a 4% to 10% GDP aim for the digital sector.
